metadata.description: Pay with a QR code and earn rewards instantly, in your own currency.

landing.tagline: Pay and earn rewards at your favorite shops.
landing.createWarning: If you already had an account, sign in with your previous passkey to access your balance.
landing.otherDeviceHint: On the next screen, choose the option to use a passkey from another phone or a security key.
landing.signedInBody: You're in. We're getting your balance and rewards ready.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Two details and your fingerprint. No password needed.
register.alreadyHaveAccount: Already had an account? Sign in with your fingerprint to get your balance back instead of creating another one.
register.name: Your name
register.nameError: Enter a name between 2 and 40 characters.
register.emailHint: We keep it as your account's contact detail.
register.fingerprintNotice: You will confirm with your fingerprint next. That fingerprint is your account key: we never store a password.
register.profileFailed: We created your account, but we couldn't save your name and email.

newMerchant.title: Register your business
newMerchant.description: Find your place and confirm the details. It can take payments right away: nobody has to approve it.
newMerchant.searchHint: Pick your place from the list and we fill the details in. You can also type them by hand.
newMerchant.searchDown: The search is unavailable right now. Fill the details in by hand and carry on.
newMerchant.name: Business name
newMerchant.nameError: Enter a name between 2 and 60 characters.
newMerchant.categoryError: Pick a category from the list.
newMerchant.countryError: Enter the country as two letters, for example AR.
newMerchant.currencyHint: We pick it from the country. Your customers pay in their own currency and the conversion is automatic.
newMerchant.currencyError: Pick a currency from the list.
newMerchant.emailError: Enter a valid email address or leave it empty.
newMerchant.confirmation: You will use your fingerprint once. That enables your business to take payments in {currency}.
newMerchant.personAddress: This is already your personal account. Register your business from the Home menu.
newMerchant.activationFailed: We couldn't enable your business. Try again in a moment.
newMerchant.tooMany: This account already has the maximum number of businesses.
newMerchant.doneTitle: Done! Your business can take payments
newMerchant.doneBody: Your charges will be in {currency}. Create your first charge and show the code to your customer.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.wrongAccount: That passkey belongs to another account. Choose this account's passkey.
errors.network: We couldn't reach RewApp. Check your connection and try again.
errors.passkeyFailed: We couldn't read your passkey. Try again or use another device.
errors.prfUnavailable: This passkey manager doesn't work with RewApp. Try Google's or Apple's, or another device.
errors.browserUnsupported: Your browser doesn't support RewApp. Update it or try another one.
errors.backupFailed: We couldn't open your backup passkey. Try your main passkey.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again with your passkey.

money.simulatedFx: Simulated exchange rate for the demo.

session.confirmBody: For your security we paused your session. Use your fingerprint or face to continue.

home.protectBody: Add a backup passkey in case you lose this phone.
home.noMerchants: Pay with RewApp at a store and your visits and rewards will show up here.
home.visitsLeft: {count, plural, one {# more visit to your reward} other {# more visits to your reward}}
home.loadError: We couldn't update your balance. Try again.

topUp.title: Add money
topUp.limit: You can add up to {amount} at a time.
topUp.simulated: This is a test top-up: no real money is charged.

errors.rateLimited: Too many top-ups in a row. Try again in a while.
errors.outOfRange: That amount is over the limit per top-up.
errors.failed: We couldn't add money. Try again.
errors.serviceUnavailable: We can't add money right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

topUp.successHint: Your balance is ready for your next payment.

backup.title: Protect your balance
backup.body: Add a backup passkey on another device or a security key. If you lose this phone, the backup gets you into the same account.
backup.hint: First confirm with your usual fingerprint, then create the new passkey. To use another phone, choose "Use another device".
backup.doneBody: You can now sign in with either of your two passkeys.

redeem.title: Redeem
redeem.soon: Soon you'll be able to redeem your RewPoints for rewards.

scan.imageInvalid: Choose an image up to 20 MB.
scan.imageNoQr: No QR code was found in that image. Try a clearer image.
scan.title: Scan
scan.body: Point the camera at the store's QR code.
scan.notRewApp: That QR code isn't from RewApp.

errors.denied: We need permission to use the camera. Allow it in your browser and try again.

cardSelector.title: Your cards
cardSelector.description: Keep your cards handy for your next payments.
cardSelector.payTitle: How would you like to pay?
cardSelector.payDescription: Choose a method to continue with your payment.
cardSelector.emptyDescription: Once you add a card, it will appear here.
cardSelector.loadError: We couldn’t load your cards. Please try again.

pay.slideHelp: Drag the handle to the right end and release to confirm. With a keyboard, press Enter or Space. Escape cancels the slide.
pay.cardUnavailable: Card payments will be available later. For now, choose your RewApp balance.

closed.paidHint: You can view the receipt from the account that made the payment.
closed.hint: Ask the store to show you a new QR code.

errors.expired: This charge expired. Ask the store for a new QR code.
errors.overLimit: You went over the limit per payment or per day.
errors.passkey: We couldn't confirm it's you. Try again.
errors.failed: We couldn't make the payment. Try again.
errors.serviceUnavailable: We can't process payments right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.processing: We are confirming your payment. Wait before trying again.

receipt.shareError: We could not share your receipt. You can save a PDF using the print button.
receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.error: We could not retrieve your receipt. Check that the operation is confirmed and you are using the corresponding account.

addCard.title: Add a card
addCard.description: Save your card to your account.
addCard.notice: We register identifying card details. Card payments are not available yet.
addCard.confirmation: Confirm with your passkey. We save the brand, last four digits, cardholder name and expiry.
addCard.duplicate: This card is already linked to your account. You can choose another.
addCard.doneBody: Your card is saved to your account. Card payments are not available yet.
addCard.numberHint: Enter only the last four digits.
addCard.holderError: Enter a name between 2 and 80 characters.
addCard.expiryError: Enter MM/YY after the current month, with a month from 01 to 12 and no more than 20 years ahead.
addCard.invalidDetails: Check the last four digits, cardholder name and unexpired date.
addCard.saveError: We could not save your card. Please try again.

demoCharge.title: Test charge
demoCharge.description: Choose a test: a Café Demo QR or a payment request from a demo contact. Local testing only.
demoCharge.qrAlt: QR code for the Café Demo test charge
demoCharge.expired: This QR code has expired. Generate another to keep testing.
demoCharge.error: We couldn’t generate the charge. Check that the database is available and try again.
demoCharge.noticeOption: Send me a test payment request
demoCharge.noticeSent: A demo contact sent you a request for ARS 5,000. Open your notifications to test paying it.

workspace.connectBody: Confirm your identity to view contacts, groups and redemptions.
workspace.failed: We could not complete this action. Check the details and try again.
workspace.chargeUnavailable: This bill was split, is being processed or expired. Refresh shared bills.
workspace.unknownContact: Add every participant to your contacts first.
workspace.notReady: This code is not for a reward ready for pickup at your business.
workspace.handleTaken: That alias belongs to another account.
workspace.invalidHandle: Use a valid alias with 3–24 characters.
workspace.tooManyRequests: You created several requests in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
workspace.requestsBlocked: This contact does not accept payment requests from your account.

social.title: Friends and groups
social.body: Organize contacts and share payments at businesses.
social.splitBody: Choose who shares the bill. Everyone pays their part and earns their own points.
social.invalidCode: We could not use this code or copy the link. Check it and try again.
social.emptyContacts: Ask a friend for their account code and add them here.
social.groupHint: Select contacts above to create a group, or choose an existing group to share a payment. Up to 12 participants, including you.
social.divisionHint: The total is divided among {count} people, including you. Splitting does not pay the bill. The original bill will stop accepting full payments.
social.emptySplits: Your shared bills will appear here. Open a business QR and choose Share this payment to split it.
social.otherParticipant: This part belongs to someone else
social.statusHint: Check shared bills or sign in with the invited account. If payment is processing, wait for confirmation.

rewards.title: Your points, your rewards
rewards.body: Choose a reward and redeem it with RewPoints.
rewards.confirmBody: {count} RewPoints will be deducted when redemption is confirmed. Then show your code at the business to collect it.
rewards.emptyHistory: Your redeemed rewards will appear here.
rewards.processing: We are confirming your redemption. Check your history shortly.
rewards.pickupHint: Show this code at the business. It can only be used once.
rewards.success: Redemption confirmed! Your code is in Your redemptions.
rewards.failed: We could not confirm redemption. Check Your redemptions before trying again.
rewards.insufficient: You do not have enough points for this reward.

merchantRewards.title: Your business rewards
merchantRewards.body: Manage rewards, payment benefits and pickups.
merchantRewards.notMerchant: This account is not registered as a business. Ask the team to register it to enable this panel.
merchantRewards.pickBusiness: Choose a business from your profile.
merchantRewards.unlinked: This business is registered. Link it to your profile to open it.
merchantRewards.catalogHint: Edit rewards assigned to your business and pause new redemptions. Point costs and new rewards are configured by the administrator.
merchantRewards.ruleHint: Choose cashback on each payment or a reward every few visits. Applies to new payments, including each share of a shared bill.
merchantRewards.pending: The rule is awaiting confirmation. Check its status before saving again.
merchantRewards.failed: We could not confirm this rule. Try again later.
merchantRewards.deliveryHint: Ask the customer for their code and confirm after handing over the reward.
merchantRewards.eventsHint: Publish an event and your customers will see it in their notifications. You can have one active event at a time.
merchantRewards.published: Your event is now visible to your customers.
merchantRewards.eventActiveExists: You already have an active event. Wait for it to end before publishing another.
merchantRewards.eventFailed: We could not publish your event. Try again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: No notifications yet. When there is a new reward or an event at your shops, we will tell you here.
notifications.loadError: We could not load your notifications. Try again.

reward.newBody: It is already in the catalog and costs {cost} RewPoints.
reward.reachableBody: You collected the {cost} RewPoints. Open Rewards and redeem it whenever you like.

birthday.title: Happy birthday!
birthday.body: A gift is waiting for you. Redeem it in Rewards, once a year.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: Pay with QR at your shops and earn RewPoints with every purchase.

catalog.title: Check the rewards catalog
catalog.body: Your RewPoints can be redeemed for rewards from your favorite shops.

personal.title: Payment request
personal.body: {name} is requesting {amount}. Open the request to review it and decide whether to pay.

shared.title: Shared payment
shared.body: Your share at {merchant} is {amount}. Open the payment to review and pay.

business.title: Your business
business.missing: We could not find that business.
business.notYours: This business is not linked to your account.
business.registersHint: Each register shows customers and sales for the last 7 days, in the currency you charge.
business.noRegisters: There are no registers yet. Add the first one so you can charge.
business.registerLimit: This business already has the maximum number of registers.
business.registerFailed: We could not add the register. Try again.
business.chargeBody: Create a QR for {name} so the customer can pay in {currency}.
business.lockedHint: This register stays open. To leave it, confirm with your passkey.
business.leaveFailed: We could not confirm leaving. Try again.
business.registerGone: This register is no longer available. Confirm with your passkey to leave.
business.needRegister: Add a register on the panel before charging.
business.amountError: Enter an amount greater than zero.
business.chargeFailed: We could not create the charge. Try again.

profile.title: My profile
profile.name: Name or nickname
profile.confirmation: Confirm your identity with your passkey to save changes.
profile.error: We could not complete this action. Try again.
profile.codeHint: Share it with friends so they can invite you to shared payments.
profile.backupMissing: You have not added a backup passkey yet.
profile.securityHint: Sign in with your fingerprint or face. A backup helps you recover access if you lose your device.
profile.businessesHint: Open the panel of each business you registered under your name.
profile.noBusinesses: You have not registered a business yet.
profile.birthdayHint: We ask once so we can give you something on your birthday. It cannot be changed later.
profile.birthdayLocked: Your birthday is already saved and cannot be changed.

streak.title: Your streak
streak.startBody: Pay with RewApp 5 days in a row and win a {points} RewPoints pot. Every day adds more.
streak.activeBody: You already counted today. Come back tomorrow and your pot grows to {points} RewPoints.
streak.pendingTitle: Day {day} of {total}: pay today to keep going
streak.pendingBody: Pay today and your pot grows to {points} RewPoints.
streak.atRiskBodyHours: Your {points} RewPoints pot is still safe. {count, plural, one {You have # hour} other {You have # hours}} left to pay and keep it.
streak.atRiskBodyDays: Your {points} RewPoints pot is still safe. {count, plural, one {You have # day} other {You have # days}} left to pay and keep it.
streak.brokenBody: 3 days went by without a payment and the pot was lost. Pay today and start again.
streak.claimableBody: Your {points} RewPoints pot is waiting. It never expires: claim it whenever you like.
streak.claimedBody: A new streak for another {points} RewPoints starts tomorrow.
streak.rule: One payment a day from {amount} counts, at any store.
streak.celebrationNext: They are already in your points balance. A new streak starts tomorrow.

errors.passkey: We couldn't confirm it's you. Please try again.
errors.serviceUnavailable: We're very busy right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.failed: We couldn't collect your pot. Please try again.

demoStreak.title: Test streak
demoStreak.description: Sets up this account's streak for a demo. It only changes the days, never the points. Testing only.
demoStreak.error: We couldn't set up the streak. Please try again.

almost.label: Almost done (4 of 5)
almost.hint: Pay today to complete the 5 days.

claimable.label: Ready to claim (5 of 5)
claimable.hint: The 110 RewPoints pot can be claimed now.

personal.aliasHint: Choose a unique alias with 3–24 characters: letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores. Start and end with a letter or number. Case insensitive.
personal.noPoints: Payments between people do not earn RewPoints.
personal.processing: Your payment is being confirmed. Please do not send it again; check its status here.
personal.sent: The request is now in your contact’s notifications. It expires in 24 hours.
personal.qrHint: Show this QR or share the link to receive payment. Expires in 24 hours.
personal.confirmHint: Check the recipient and amount before sliding to pay.
personal.insufficientFunds: You do not have enough funds. Add funds and try again.
personal.payerBusy: Another transfer is processing. Wait for confirmation before sending another.
personal.failed: We could not complete the transaction. Check its status before trying again.
personal.transferHint: Choose a contact and the amount to send from your balance.
personal.requestHint: Request payment from a contact or create a QR for someone to pay you.
personal.noticeBody: {name} is requesting {amount}. Open the request to review it and decide whether to pay.
personal.handleTaken: That alias belongs to another account.
personal.invalidHandle: Use a valid alias with 3–24 characters.
personal.tooManyRequests: You created several requests in a row. Wait a minute and try again.

contactDetails.blockHint: Cancels their pending requests and prevents new ones. You can still send them money.
contactDetails.movementsHint: Your last 30 confirmed payments with this contact. Tap one to view its receipt.
contactDetails.emptyMovements: No confirmed payments with this contact yet.
contactDetails.deleteSelected: {count, plural, one {Delete selected contact} other {Delete # selected contacts}}
contactDetails.groupLimit: Select up to 11 contacts to create a group.
contactDetails.groupHint: Choose one of your groups to add the selected contacts. Maximum 12 members, including you.
contactDetails.qrOnlyHint: Create a QR code to show or share.
contactDetails.contactOnlyHint: Your contact will receive a request in their notifications.
contactDetails.transferContactHint: Choose who you want to send the payment to.
